headline: WIX Q2 Earnings Beat Expectations, Revenue Rises Y/Y on Base44 Strength
summary: Wix beat second-quarter earnings and revenue estimates as Base44 fueled growth, while heavier AI spending pressured margins and shaped the outlook.
